articles.title: WhatsApp May Stop Working Without Registered SIM Under New Rules
articles.summary:
WhatsApp users in India may face access issues without a registered SIM under new government rules expected to take effect on January 1, 2027. Messaging platforms reportedly have until December 31, 2026, to comply. The change could affect people using accounts on secondary phones, tablets, and devices without an active registered SIM. articles.title: Critical Okta Access Gateway Flaw Lets Attackers With Admin Access Execute System Commands
articles.summary:
Okta has disclosed a critical security flaw in Okta Access Gateway that lets an authenticated administrator run system commands through the appliance’s Admin Console. Tracked as CVE-2026-115547, the vulnerability affects versions before 2026.10.2 and has a CVSS v3.1 score of 9.1, according to the October 22, 2026 advisory. articles.title: HPE Warns Critical Aruba Networking Flaws Could Let Hackers Take Complete Control of Devices
articles.summary:
Hewlett Packard Enterprise has released security patches for multiple vulnerabilities in Aruba Networking wireless software that could let attackers take complete control of affected devices. The flaws affect AOS-8 and AOS-10 deployments across Mobility Conductors, Controllers, Gateways, and access points. Several allow attacks without a valid login, making prompt patching a priority for network administrators. […]

articles.title: Japanese Game Maker Capcom Has Confirmed – 11,774,247 Customer Records Exposed
articles.summary:
Capcom has announced plans to notify customers after unauthorized access to its CAPCOM ID service affected 11,774,247 records worldwide. The Japanese game publisher disclosed the incident on October 22, 2026, saying the exposed information included email addresses and details of account activity. Attackers also changed passwords on 196 accounts without permission. Capcom has reset those […]

articles.title: Multiple Waves of DDoS Attacks Caused This Week’s Outage in North Korea
articles.summary:
Multiple waves of DDoS attacks disrupted North Korea’s public internet services this week, knocking major state websites offline. Kentik’s internet analysis director Doug Madory linked the outages to sudden traffic floods from Vietnam, the Philippines, Venezuela, and other countries. articles.title: New Node2Shell Node.js RCE Exploit Let Attackers Execute Malicious Code Through Brotli-Compressed Data
articles.summary:
Researchers has demonstrated Node2Shell, a working exploit that lets an attacker run code inside a Node.js application through specially crafted, Brotli-compressed data. The research targets CVE-2026-111497, a high-severity memory flaw in the Brotli decoder bundled with Node.js. The Node.js security advisory, published on October 21, 2026, confirms that the flaw can allow remote code execution […]

The post New Node2Shell Node.js RCE Exploit Let Attackers Execute Malicious Code Through Brotli-Compressed Data appeared first on Cyber Security News.

articles.title: Hackers Actively Exploiting Critical VeloCloud Orchestrator Flaw to Gain Superuser Access
articles.summary:
Hackers are actively exploiting a critical SQL injection flaw in VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) that allows logged-in users to gain superuser operator access. Arista Networks disclosed the vulnerability on October 22, 2026, warning that successful attacks could compromise the orchestrator, its host, and the data it manages. Arista has already patched hosted deployments, including Dedicated instances. […]

articles.title: StealC Malware Returns as New Stadia RAT to Steal Passwords and Secretly Control Windows PCs
articles.summary:
The seller behind StealC has returned with Stadia, a Windows remote access trojan that combines password theft with hidden desktop control. Advertised on October 16, 2026, the malware expands beyond stealing data, allowing criminals to run commands, browse files, manage processes, and load more malicious software. articles.title: Hackers Use New BlackX Bootkit to Bypass Windows Secure Boot on Fully Patched Systems
articles.summary:

The malware targets Secure Boot, a feature designed to help stop untrusted software from running before Windows starts.
